title: 廿四味
subject: a herbal tea shop owner who looks at your tongue and tells you exactly how late you stayed up
caption: Naamyam, the Cantonese narrative song tradition of the blind street storytellers, sung as a tale about a neighbourhood character. A yehu coconut-shell fiddle leading with a nasal, sliding line and a short lead-in before the voice, a guzheng zither plucking sparse answering phrases, a dongxiao vertical bamboo flute holding long low notes between verses, a single wooden clapper marking the end of each couplet. Sparse and intimate, close like a teahouse corner, the voice dry and clearly forward. Solo male storyteller voice, half-sung and half-spoken, with lingering melismatic cadences at the end of each line. 60 BPM, D major, flexible and rubato. Wry, warm storytelling. No drum kit, no pop chords, no synths, no Western strings, no autotune, no Cantonese opera gongs and cymbals, no operatic falsetto.
lyrics:
[Verse]
話說上海街 有間涼茶舖
開咗五十年 冇招牌 都冇人行錯路
老闆叫成叔 戴副厚眼鏡
佢唔問你邊度唔妥 叫你伸條脷 睇一眼就心中有數

[Verse]
後生仔伸條脷 成叔嘖一聲
「琴晚三點先瞓 食咗包薯片 唔好話冇」
後生仔嚇到 成碗涼茶一啖飲晒
成叔笑笑口 話條脷 識打小報告

[Chorus]
廿四味一碗 十年冇加過價
苦到你成塊面皺埋 佢先點頭話好
「飲完返去 早啲瞓
聽日唔使嚟見我 先至最好」

[Bridge]
其實成叔眼鏡咁厚 條脷邊睇得到
係你阿媽朝早坐咗成個鐘 乜都講晒佢知道

[Chorus]
廿四味一碗 十年冇加過價
苦到你成塊面皺埋 佢先點頭話好
「飲完返去 早啲瞓
記得覆你阿媽WhatsApp 好唔好」

[Outro]
銅葫蘆 照舊擺喺門口
成叔九點熄燈 佢自己一向瞓得好早
